executionDecision.reason: The no-mixed-generation guarantee depends on every supported reader consulting the nonterminal promotion journal as well as cooperating on hris-verification. Static inspection found direct live readers with no promotion-journal fence call; a PREPARED, COMMITTING, or FINALIZING crash state could therefore be consumed after the writer releases its semaphore.

readerFenceCoverageAudit.centralFenceLimitation: central_transaction_fence.py correctly evaluates the optional promotion journal only when a caller invokes it. It is not automatically interposed on file reads and its self-test does not demonstrate that active readers invoke it.
readerFenceCoverageAudit.acceptanceEvidenceLimitation: The promotion tool compares readerFenceCoverage to a PASS string in supplied evidence; it does not discover or enforce the actual reader set. Independent evidence cannot truthfully set that check to PASS at this revision.

requiredClosuresBeforeAnyGO: Define the authoritative active-reader inventory for all 16 destination paths, including direct CLI validators, Gate/readiness orchestrators, generators, and physical readers.

Route every supported reader through one mandatory wrapper that acquires hris-verification and invokes the promotion-journal fence before any destination snapshot/read; direct bypasses must fail closed.

Add hostile integration tests that persist PREPARED, COMMITTING, FINALIZING, malformed, COMMITTED, and ROLLED_BACK journals and demonstrate each inventoried reader blocks or admits exactly as required after writer-lock release.
Reconcile the downstream execution plan's stale six-physical-artifact wording with the exact eight physical files.
Create fresh, independently accepted canonical and physical candidates. Existing candidates and derivatives remain non-promotable diagnostic evidence.

Only after these closures may an independent acceptance artifact truthfully use the required acceptance schema and set readerFenceCoverage to PASS; then create a unique immutable spec and run its read-only preflight before any separate promotion authorization.
